name: research-tree
description: research-tree for ML method discovery in Claude Code: /research-tree init <plan.md> sets up a uv project, a research database and a research-tree.yaml config (platform, budget, gates, subagent models) in the current directory, the main session plans as Research Leader, the UI agent talks with you in a window, and one worker per node implements and evaluates after you confirm the plan. Bundles its Python tools, schema and rules.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who the main session is in the research team (<role>/<agent-id>); UI and worker runs are fixed by the mod.
